voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

chunks.text: AI can help teenagers and students learn in several ways.
Personalised learning: AI can know better about students, including their advantages, weaknesses, skills, learning favourites, and learning needs, and so on.
Then it can create a proper learning plan for each student.
This can help students concentrate on areas that they need to improve at their own speed.
Interactive learning: Forget about the learning method of yesterday!
AI has the ability to make learning more interactive and interesting.
Interactive learning apps and educational games can make students learn more carefully.
The new method is sure to be more helpful than studying alone.
Automated advice and help: AI can examine students' work and provide personalised help.
For example, ChatGPT can answer students' questions quickly in a private, low-pressure way.
This kind of advice and answers can help students better understand knowledge and use their knowledge.
Greater resources: AI can make learning resources richer and wider, like electronic textbooks, online courses, and study apps.
For example, a biology textbook with AI technology may provide interactive 3D models of a human body.
Students may also be able to talk to a simulated empress in history to know more about her life, for example,
whom she chose to marry and why.
AI can provide interactive examples, introduce important passages, and offer assessments.
In a word, AI has a great ability to improve studying and learning.
By using AI, students can study smarter and reach higher levels of learning and success.
The future of AI in education is hopeful as technologies continue to develop.
